info.title: Dual U
info.author: tech-will
info.description: Connect 2 gamepads at the same time!
info.details:
Dual-U
This Wii U plugin allows to connect 2 Wii U gamepads at the same time! It can stream sound, controls and video.

Back in E3 2012, Nintendo announced that two Wii U gamepads can be connected to the console at the same time. This feature was never released, but it is still in the system files and can be used in homebrew applications. This plugin allows you to play games with two gamepads!

Features:
- Pair the Wii U gamepads
- Turn the plugin on and off
- Switch controller mode between mirrored (acts as the same controller for both Wii U gamepads) and Separate (The second gamepad pretends to be a Wii U pro controller)
- Reload Wii U button to easily connect both of the gamepads
- Switch video source between Gamepad and TV

Controls:
- Press left stick and right stick together to change the controller mode between Separate and Mirrored.
- Press Right D-Pad and Y button to switch video source between Gamepad and TV.

Visit the GitHub: https://github.com/tech-will/Dual-U for more information.

changelog:
v1.0
I have added even more performance options, a controller mapping selector - so you can have other controllers connected, and the ability to use the touchscreen even if you have Separate mode enabled. This update brings it out of beta, because now I believe it is finished enough.

v0.7
I added motion controls. You can enable it in the plugin config. There is two types, Mirrored (Merges the motion controls into the first gamepad) and Separate (Wii Remote). Separate (Wii Remote) simulates the secret motion controls setup in Splatoon Battle Dojo. See https://splatoonus.tumblr.com/post/120246428234/one-of-our-scientists-has-made-a-rather-stunning

v0.6
I finally managed to fix video after like two months! Video is now clear on the second gamepad. You can now switch between gamepad video and TV video to display on the second gamepad. It's on the config menu and you can also now use a button combination to control it.

v0.5
Added a performance toggle in the plugin setting that partly fixed an issue where two gamepads would slow down the console. This only partly works because the Wii U needs to be in the Quick Start menu to work as a controller.

v0.4
Fixed version number in plugin and changed L Stick + R stick shortcut to change the controller mode.

v0.3
Added Rumble to the second gamepad.

v0.2
Fixed some bugs where some games didn't work with separate controllers. This release also added the ability to use the gamepad on the Wii U menu in Separate mode, so it no longer shows a greyed-out hand.
